description: This file defines the GrainLocatorResolver class responsible for resolving grain locators based on grain types within the Orleans runtime environment. It manages different locator strategies such as cached, DHT-based, and client-specific locators.

classes.name: GrainLocatorResolver
classes.description: A class that determines and provides the appropriate grain locator for a given grain type, optimized for Orleans' runtime.

methods.name: GrainLocatorResolver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the resolver.

methods.name: GetGrainLocator
methods.description: Retrieves the grain locator for a specified grain type, using caching to ensure singleton-like behavior.

methods.name: GetGrainLocatorInternal
methods.description: Determines the specific locator to use based on whether the grain type is a client, uses default directory, or falls back to cached locator.
